analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive sessions. RSI declined from the mid-60s to 60.9, failing to enter overbought territory. MACD histogram worsened to -470.8412, continuing its bearish trend post-death cross. Volume ratio at 1.07 relative to the 5-day average indicates no significant buying or selling pressure. Current price of $78,741.47 is consolidating near the Bollinger Band middle line at $78,719.91. Weekly ADX at 47.0 shows strong trend intensity, but the lack of clear direction on the daily chart warrants continued observation.
